classification.terminology_boundary: Denominator clearing, integrality factor, and cleared error term are established language. Denominator tax is an explanatory metaphor, not a located standard theorem name.
nearest_prior_work: Coussement and Smet (2009) treat Lambert series with a rational parameter q_1=s_1/t_1 and construct explicit factors making Padé approximants integral; their denominator factors contribute directly to the asymptotic budget.
Van Assche (2001) treats the adjacent reciprocal-integer q-base Lambert setting by Padé approximation with little q-Legendre polynomials.
Neither source states the card's abstract one-step tail recurrence or the exact s=1 versus s>=2 natural forcing dichotomy.
classification.attribution: Call the recurrence elementary denominator-clearing algebra. Attribute the abstract Lean API, sharp natural lower bound, and exact normalization boundary to the local source; cite rational-parameter Padé work only for the established clearing-factor framework.
classification.mathematical_interest: Low standalone depth but useful methodological precision: it makes a normalization cost explicit before an integer-base argument is transferred to a nonintegral rational base.
classification.reusable_scope: Power-series and Lambert-type tails evaluated at a rational base r/s and cleared only by numerator powers r^N, with arbitrary rational coefficient sequences.
classification.why_it_matters: At 3/2, the denominator base contributes a factor 2^(N+1) to every positive forcing step. Any cancellation, height, or Padé construction must account for that factor rather than importing an integer-base recurrence unchanged.

mechanism_comparison.elementary_core: Expanding P_(N+1)-P_N and multiplying by B r^(N+1) gives T_(N+1)=r T_N-B c_(N+1) s^(N+1).
mechanism_comparison.forcing_bound: For natural data with s>=2 and positive B,c_(N+1), monotonicity gives 2^(N+1)<=s^(N+1)<=B c_(N+1) s^(N+1).
mechanism_comparison.integer_boundary: At s=1 the denominator-base power disappears exactly, leaving A_N=B c_(N+1).
mechanism_comparison.literature_relation: Padé papers use much more elaborate global clearing factors. They confirm that clearing cost is standard and consequential, but do not turn this local recurrence into a named theorem.
mechanism_comparison.exact_delta: A compact division-free Lean interface exposes the coefficient-independent recurrence, the sharp natural bound, and the normalization discontinuity as reusable inputs.
